_note: Documented demo configuration only. Portfolio Pilot has no JSON importer — import the CSV files through Prices → Import CSV. All prices below are deterministic simulated data, not live market quotes.

scenarios.label: Steady growth (2024)
scenarios.story: ALPHA climbs with wobbles, BETA trends up, GAMMA drifts higher, NIFTY50 gains 7%. With 10/20/5 units the portfolio ends near 3490 from 3000 — about +16.3% cumulative.

scenarios.label: Dip and recovery (2023)
scenarios.story: ALPHA falls to 62 then recovers to 95, BETA slides all year, GAMMA climbs steadily. With 10/20/5 units the portfolio ends near 2935 from 2950 — about -0.5% cumulative with a visible mid-year drawdown.
